title: Salesforce Acquires Defense Tech Startup Rune for $375M
excerpt: Salesforce is expanding its defense capabilities with a reported $375 million acquisition of AI logistics startup Rune.
body_html: Salesforce is continuing its acquisition activity with a reported $375 million deal to purchase Rune, a defense tech startup. The transaction brings the artificial intelligence logistics company into the fold to strengthen the customer relationship management giant's Missionforce defense platform.
